text.hi: विशेषण (adjective) बताता है कोई कैसा है: a happy boy। क्रिया-विशेषण (adverb) बताता है काम कैसे हुआ: he smiled happily। ज़्यादातर में -ly लगता है। happy में y → i: happily।
text.hinglish: Visheshan (adjective) bataata hai koi kaisa hai: a happy boy. Kriya-visheshan (adverb) bataata hai kaam kaise hua: he smiled happily. Zyaadatar mein -ly lagta hai. happy mein y → i: happily.
text.en: An adjective tells what someone is like: a happy boy. An adverb tells how something is done: he smiled happily. Most add -ly; happy changes y to i: happily.

instruction.hi: विशेषण को उसके -ly रूप से जोड़ो
instruction.hinglish: Visheshan ko uske -ly roop se jodo
instruction.en: Join each adjective to its adverb

steps.sentence: The teacher said ___, "I will find a way to help you."

meaning.hi: टीचर ने सोच-समझकर कहा, ‘मैं तुम्हारी मदद का रास्ता निकालूँगा।’
meaning.hinglish: Teacher ne soch-samajhkar kaha, ‘Main tumhari madad ka raasta nikaaloonga.’

steps.sentence: The cap seller said ___, "All my caps are gone."

meaning.hi: टोपीवाले ने दुखी होकर कहा, ‘मेरी सारी टोपियाँ चली गईं।’
meaning.hinglish: Topiwaale ne dukhi hokar kaha, ‘Meri saari topiyaan chali gayin.’

steps.sentence: The patient slept ___ after the doctor gave him some medicine.

meaning.hi: दवा के बाद मरीज़ आराम से सोया।
meaning.hinglish: Dava ke baad mareez aaraam se soya.

steps.sentence: Ramesh went home ___ after watching the play.

meaning.hi: नाटक देखकर रमेश ख़ुशी-ख़ुशी घर गया।
meaning.hinglish: Naatak dekhkar Ramesh khushi-khushi ghar gaya.

steps.sentence: Once he got his money he went home ___.

meaning.hi: पैसे मिलते ही वह जल्दी से घर गया।
meaning.hinglish: Paise milte hi woh jaldi se ghar gaya.

steps.sentence: The lion roared ___, "Who woke me up?"

meaning.hi: शेर ज़ोर से दहाड़ा, ‘मुझे किसने जगाया?’
meaning.hinglish: Sher zor se dahaada, ‘Mujhe kisne jagaaya?’
